endpoints.title: Get Asset Labels
endpoints.description:
Lists the organization's asset entity labels for a category. `:category` is one of
`manufacturer`, `device_model`, `device_type`, `status`. Returns `{ items: [{ id, name }] }`.

On Create/Update Asset, each of these label fields accepts either the returned `{ "id": ... }`
or a plain name string (e.g. `"manufacturer": "Sony"`) — a name is resolved to an existing
label or a new one is created for the organization.

endpoints.title: Get Device
endpoints.description:
## Success
**200 OK** — a single device object.
```json
{
  "id": "1ad4e4e4-99b4-...",
  "name": "DSP-X200",
  "sn": "5pOLfS-...",
  "mac": null,
  "cloud_id": "...",
  "status": "online",
  "effective_status": "ok",
  "merged_effective_status": "ok",
  "last_seen_at": "2024-07-29T10:18:39.267Z",
  "details": null,
  "state": {},
  "model": { "id": "...", "name": "DSP-X200", "sub_model": null },
  "firmware": { "version": "1.0.0" },
  "space": { "id": 16138, "full_path": "Green Energy Corp/United Kingdom/London/Executive Suite" },
  "connector": { "type": "native", "id": null, "name": null },
  "maintenance": {
    "manual": { "active": false, "source": null },
    "scheduled": { "active": true, "until": "2026-10-21T04:00:00Z" }
  }
}
```
### Status fields
- `status` — the device's own raw self-reported state (`online` / `offline` / `unavailable` / `error`).
- `effective_status` — the device's own computed status: one of `ok`, `offline`, `error`, `warning`, `disconnected`, `never_seen`.
- `merged_effective_status` — merge-aware rollup of `effective_status` across the device group (primary + merged shadows), maintained on the group primary's row. On every other row — standalone or merged shadow — it mirrors that device's own `effective_status`.
- `connector` — `{ type, id, name }`: `type` is `native`, `c2c` or `edge`; `id` is the cloud connector or Edge id and `name` its display name (e.g. `Poly Lens`), `null` for native devices.

### Maintenance
- `maintenance.manual.active` — the device is in manual maintenance (its own incidents snoozed, or its space in maintenance).
- `maintenance.manual.source` — `device_snooze` when the device's own snooze is active, else `space` when its space is in maintenance, else `null`.
- `maintenance.scheduled.active` — a scheduled maintenance window covers the device's space now (see Maintenance Schedules); `maintenance.scheduled.until` is when it ends, `null` when none is active. Indication only: it does not change `status` or `effective_status`.

## Custom parameters (edge devices only)
For edge devices, the response includes a `custom_parameters` object — the device's current custom parameter values keyed by the field's human-readable label. This mirrors the `custom_parameters` object accepted by **Update Device**, so the object round-trips: read it, edit it, send it back. The field is omitted entirely for non-edge devices.

- **Password-type** parameters are never echoed back: a set password is masked as `"*****"`, and an unset password is returned as an empty string `""`.
- Non-password parameters with **no value set** are returned as `null`.

```json
{
  "custom_parameters": {
    "SNMP community": "public",
    "Port": "161",
    "Password": "*****"
  }
}
```

endpoints.title: Get Devices
endpoints.description:
## Query parameters
- `page` — page number (default `1`).
- `per_page` — results per page (default `100`, **max `100`**). Values above `100` are rejected with `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
- `space_id` — optional, filter to a single space.
- `name` — optional, case-insensitive substring match on the device name.
- `status` — optional, raw status: one or more of `online`, `offline`, `unavailable`, `error`. Comma-separated (`status=online,error`) or repeated (`status[]=online&status[]=error`).
- `effective_status` — optional, one or more of `ok`, `warning`, `error`, `offline`, `disconnected`, `never_seen`. Same list forms as `status`. Status filters can trail the live `status` by up to a minute.
- `model_id` — optional, device model id (UUID).
- `connection_method` — optional, one of `native`, `c2c`, `edge`.
- `connector_id` — optional, the cloud connector (C2C integration) or Edge id (UUID) — the `connector.id` of a device.

All filters combine with AND.

## Errors
> **Behavior change:** unknown query parameters used to be ignored. They are now rejected with `422`, so drop any extra parameter (a cache-buster, a `sort=`) your requests still send.

**422 Unprocessable Entity** — an unsupported query parameter, or an invalid filter value:
```json
{ "error": "Unsupported query parameter(s): foo. Supported: page, per_page, space_id, name, status, effective_status, model_id, connection_method, connector_id" }
```
```json
{ "error": "Invalid status: sleeping. status must be one or more of the following: offline / online / unavailable / error" }
```
`model_id` / `connector_id` that are not UUIDs are rejected with `"<param> must be a valid UUID"`.

## Success
**200 OK** — paginated list of devices.
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "c66308c8-1d12-...",
      "name": "Digital Media Player 2",
      "sn": "Q3RzbMS8-...",
      "mac": null,
      "cloud_id": "...",
      "status": "online",
      "effective_status": "ok",
      "merged_effective_status": "ok",
      "last_seen_at": "2024-07-24T07:22:20.037Z",
      "details": null,
      "model": { "id": "...", "name": "Digital Media Player", "sub_model": null },
      "firmware": { "version": "1.0.0" },
      "space": { "id": 17517, "full_path": "Green Energy Corp/France/Paris Demo Conference Room" },
      "connector": { "type": "c2c", "id": "5b1f0c2e-7a4d-...", "name": "Poly Lens" },
      "maintenance": {
        "manual": { "active": true, "source": "space" },
        "scheduled": { "active": false, "until": null }
      }
    }
  ],
  "next_page": 2
}
```
### Status fields
- `status` — the device's own raw self-reported state (`online` / `offline` / `unavailable` / `error`).
- `effective_status` — the device's own computed status: one of `ok`, `offline`, `error`, `warning`, `disconnected`, `never_seen`.
- `merged_effective_status` — merge-aware rollup of `effective_status` across the device group (primary + merged shadows), maintained on the group primary's row. On every other row — standalone or merged shadow — it mirrors that device's own `effective_status`.

### Maintenance
- `maintenance.manual.active` — the device is in manual maintenance (its own incidents snoozed, or its space in maintenance).
- `maintenance.manual.source` — `device_snooze` when the device's own snooze is active, else `space` when its space is in maintenance, else `null`.
- `maintenance.scheduled.active` — a scheduled maintenance window covers the device's space now (see Maintenance Schedules); `maintenance.scheduled.until` is when it ends, `null` when none is active. Indication only: it does not change `status` or `effective_status`.

### Connector
- `connector.type` — how the device connects: `native`, `c2c` (cloud connector) or `edge`.
- `connector.id` — the cloud connector or Edge id; `null` for native devices.
- `connector.name` — the cloud connector's display name (e.g. `Poly Lens`), or the Edge display name; `null` for native devices.

endpoints.title: Get Histories
endpoints.description:
## Query parameters
- `from` / `to` — Unix epoch seconds. Defaults: `from` = 1 week ago, `to` = now.
  The time window between `from` and `to` must not exceed **31 days**.
- `page` / `per_page` — pagination (defaults 1 / 100, `per_page` max 1000).
- `status` — filters by the device's *current* status (`online`, `offline`, `unavailable`, `error`), not the status recorded in each history row.
- `device_id`, `space_id`, `name` — optional filters.

## Success
**200 OK** — `items` plus `has_next_page` (boolean). No total count is returned.

## Errors
**401 Unauthorized** — Missing or invalid `Authorization` header.
**422 Unprocessable Entity** — Invalid params, e.g. a `from`/`to` window wider than 31 days.

endpoints.title: Update Device
endpoints.description: `sn` and `mac` are accepted only when the device model allows editing them (the partner's "Allow org users to edit serial number" / "Allow org users to edit MAC address" model settings). `custom_model_name` and `custom_vendor_name` can be changed only on devices that connect through a C2C integration or an Edge; on devices that connect directly to Xyte they are defined by the device model and are rejected. Sending a field with its current value is not an edit. A rejected field fails the whole request with `422 Unprocessable Entity` and nothing is updated. The example body assumes an editable C2C or Edge device model.

endpoints.title: Change Model
endpoints.description:
Moves an edge device to another edge device model of the same vendor in place, for example from a Heartbeat model to the full driver for the same hardware. Moves to or from the generic Heartbeat model are allowed for an edge model of any vendor. The device keeps its id, space and incidents; only its monitoring template and parameters change. Data collected by the previous model's template is discarded.

## Parameters
- `device_model_id` (required) — The target edge device model.
- `custom_parameters` (optional) — Object of parameter name to value for the target model, same as Start Claim. Current values of parameters the target model also declares are kept unless given here.
- `custom_model_name` (optional) — Model name shown for the device. When omitted, a device still showing the previous model's name is renamed to the target model's name; any other name is kept.

## Success
**200 OK**
```json
{
  "id": "device-id",
  "previous_device_model_id": "model-id",
  "device_model_id": "model-id",
  "custom_model_name": "Model name",
  "missing_parameters": ["{$PASSWORD}"],
  "edge_update": {
    "status": "update_sent",
    "edge_version": "1.3.10",
    "latest_edge_version": "2.1.1"
  }
}
```
`missing_parameters` lists the target model's required parameters that are still empty. The driver may not collect data until they are set.

When the device's Edge is older than the latest Edge release, the Edge is sent its Update Version command and the device is moved without waiting for it; the driver starts collecting once the Edge runs the new version. `edge_update.status` is one of:
- `up_to_date` — The Edge already runs the latest release.
- `update_sent` — An Edge update was sent.
- `update_in_progress` — An Edge update was already running, so none was sent.
- `update_not_sent` — The Edge is behind, but its update could not be sent (for example, the Edge model has no Update Version command or it needs a license). Update the Edge yourself.
- `unknown_version` — The Edge's version or the latest release is unknown, so the Edge was not updated.

## Errors
**401 Unauthorized** — Missing or invalid `Authorization` header.
**404 Not Found** — Device not found in the organization.
**422 Unprocessable Entity** — The device is not an edge device; the target is not an edge model of the device's vendor (or the generic Heartbeat model, which moves to and from any vendor); the target model is not published; the device is already on the target model; `custom_parameters` contains a parameter the target model does not declare or an invalid value; or the monitoring service for the Edge couldn't be reached, in which case the device is unchanged and the call can be retried.

endpoints.title: Start Claim
endpoints.description:
## Success
**204 No Content** — Claim process started successfully. No response body.

## Optional fields
- `mac` — MAC address of the device. Accepted in any common format (e.g. `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`, `AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF`, `aabbccddeeff`); it is normalized to `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff` before being stored.
- `sn` — Serial number to assign to the device. When omitted, the device's serial defaults to its generated UUID.

## Errors
**401 Unauthorized** — Missing or invalid `Authorization` header.
**422 Unprocessable Entity** — Invalid parameters (e.g. unknown `device_model_id`, unreachable `device_ip`, malformed `mac`).

endpoints.title: Update Hostname
endpoints.description:
Updates the IP address or hostname an edge device is reachable on. The new address is synced to the monitoring server and stored on the device. The device's custom parameter values are preserved.

Unless `skip_connectivity_check` is `true`, a successful connectivity check for the new address must be performed first (see Start Ping / Get Ping Status).

## Success
**200 OK** — `{ "success": true }`

## Errors
**400 Bad Request** — Missing `device_ip`, or the new address has not passed a connectivity check.
**401 Unauthorized** — Missing or invalid `Authorization` header.
**404 Not Found** — Device not found in the organization.
**422 Unprocessable Entity** — Malformed `device_ip` (must contain only letters, digits, dots, and hyphens).

endpoints.title: Get Incidents
endpoints.description:
## Query parameters
- `page` — page number (default `1`).
- `per_page` — results per page (default `100`, **max `500`**). Values above `500` are rejected with `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
- `from` / `to` — Unix timestamps (seconds) bounding the incident's `created_at`, inclusive. Default: the last week up to now.
- `status` — optional, `active` or `closed`; filters on the stored status. A snoozed incident reads `"status": "snoozed"` but is matched by `status=active` — use `snoozed=true` / `false` to pick snoozed incidents in or out.
- `priority` — optional, `critical`, `high`, `moderate`, `low` or `planning`.
- `title`, `description`, `issue`, `device_model`, `partner_name`, `sub_model` — optional, case-insensitive substring match.
- `space_id` — optional, only incidents on devices in this space.
- `notified` — optional, `true` / `false`: only incidents whose opening notification did (or did not) reach at least one of the organization's integrations.
- `with_notifications` — optional, `true` adds `notified` and `notifications` to every item (default `false`, which leaves the payload as it always was).
- `in_maintenance` — optional, `true` / `false`: only incidents that are (or are not) in maintenance mode.
- `snoozed` — optional, `true` / `false`: only incidents that are (or are not) snoozed — active with `snoozed_until` in the future, the rows that read `"status": "snoozed"`. An expired snooze, or a closed incident that still carries one, counts as not snoozed.
- `include_suppressed` — optional, `true` also returns the incidents suppressed by a scheduled maintenance window (default `false`).

> **Behavior change:** incidents suppressed by a scheduled maintenance window are no longer listed by default, matching the Xyte portal. Pass `include_suppressed=true` to get them back.

## Pagination
Results are sorted by `created_at` ascending (oldest first), ties broken by incident id, so the order is stable across pages. Keep following `next_page` until it is `null`. Pass explicit `from` and `to` and reuse the same values for every page: both default relative to the time of each request, so a window left to the defaults moves between calls and records at page boundaries get skipped.

## Success
**200 OK** — paginated list of incidents.
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "uuid": "7f7c3a52-0f3e-...",
      "status": "active",
      "priority": "high",
      "title": "Device offline",
      "description": "Device has not reported for 10 minutes",
      "device_id": "c66308c8-1d12-...",
      "device_name": "Digital Media Player 2",
      "device_model": "Digital Media Player",
      "device_sub_model": null,
      "partner_name": "Acme AV",
      "space_id": 17517,
      "space_tree_path_name": "Green Energy Corp/France/Paris Demo Conference Room",
      "space_name": "Paris Demo Conference Room",
      "issue": "offline",
      "space_incident": false,
      "created_at": "2026-08-26T08:23:14Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-08-26T08:23:14Z",
      "in_maintenance": false,
      "entered_maintenance_at": null,
      "snoozed_until": null,
      "maintenance": {
        "scheduled": {
          "suppressed": false,
          "suppressed_until": null,
          "announced_at": null
        }
      },
      "notified": true,
      "notifications": [
        {
          "integration_id": "5f1c0d2e-7c3a-4b8e-9d21-...",
          "integration_type": "service_now",
          "status": "sent",
          "action": "create",
          "notified_at": "2026-08-26T08:23:18Z",
          "external_id": "46b66a40db98330010b6a0b5ca961905",
          "external_reference": "INC0010042",
          "external_url": "https://acme.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=incident.do?sys_id=46b66a40db98330010b6a0b5ca961905",
          "reason": null
        },
        {
          "integration_id": "9a7d4c11-2e5f-4f0b-8c3d-...",
          "integration_type": "email",
          "status": "skipped",
          "action": "create",
          "notified_at": null,
          "external_id": null,
          "external_reference": null,
          "external_url": null,
          "reason": "priority_filter"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "next_page": 2,
  "has_next_page": true,
  "total_count": 815
}
```
- `next_page` — the next page number, or `null` on the last page.
- `has_next_page` — `true` while more pages follow.
- `total_count` — how many incidents match the filters across all pages.

### Notification state (`with_notifications=true`)
`notified` and `notifications` appear only when asked for (the example above shows them). One `notifications` entry per organization integration the incident was dispatched to; `notified` is `true` once the opening notification reached at least one of them.
- `integration_type` — the integration driver (`service_now`, `jira`, `freshdesk`, `slack`, `msteams`, `email`, `web_hook`, ...).
- `status` / `reason` / `notified_at` / `external_*` describe the opening notification; later updates and closes do not change them. An update or close of an incident whose opening notification was never recorded records nothing.
- `status` — `sent` / `failed` / `skipped`; `action` — the last incident event dispatched to the integration: `create` / `update` / `close`.
- `notified_at` — when the opening notification was delivered; `null` until it is (a delivered close alone never sets it).
- `external_id` / `external_reference` / `external_url` — the record created on the integration's side: ServiceNow `sys_id` + number + link, Jira issue id, Freshdesk ticket id + link, ConnectWise ticket id, FreshService request number, Salesforce case id, Slack message `ts` + channel.
- `reason` — why it was not sent: for `failed`, `no_remote_reference`, `space_override_failed` (delivery to the space's own routing destination failed; the integration stays active) (`null` for any other delivery error); for `skipped`, `priority_filter`, `integration_inactive`, `handler_declined`, `reference_already_present` (another integration of the same ticketing type - ServiceNow, Jira, Freshdesk, ConnectWise or FreshService - had already opened the incident's ticket on that system).

Recorded from the release of this feature onward: older incidents answer `"notified": false` with an empty list.

## Maintenance and snooze
`status=active` also returns incidents in maintenance mode and snoozed incidents (a snoozed one reads `"status": "snoozed"`) unless they are filtered out.
- `in_maintenance` — `true` while the incident is in maintenance mode (its device or space is under maintenance); `entered_maintenance_at` — when it entered maintenance, `null` when not in maintenance.
- `snoozed_until` — when the snooze ends, `null` when not set; the incident is snoozed only while this is in the future.
- On a room incident (`space_incident: true`), `in_maintenance` is the room row's own flag, not its member devices'.
- To match the Active tab of the organization portal, pass `status=active&in_maintenance=false&snoozed=false&from=0&to=<now>`. The portal has no time window, while `from` defaults to one week ago; fix `to` once and reuse it on every page, as described under Pagination.

### Scheduled maintenance
Grouped under `maintenance.scheduled`, as on devices and spaces; the manual maintenance fields above stay top-level.
- `maintenance.scheduled.suppressed` — `true` while the incident is hidden because it opened inside a scheduled maintenance window (see Maintenance Schedules). A suppressed incident closed before the window ends stays suppressed.
- `maintenance.scheduled.suppressed_until` — when the window hiding it ends; `null` when not suppressed.
- `maintenance.scheduled.announced_at` — when a suppressed incident still open at the end of its window was announced as a new incident; `null` otherwise.

## Room incidents
When an organization has room incident grouping enabled, an outage of several devices in one room is returned as **one row** — the room incident — and its per-device member incidents are not listed.

- `space_incident` — `true` on a room incident, `false` on an ordinary device incident.
- On a room incident, `space_id` / `space_name` / `space_tree_path_name` describe the room, `issue` is `space_offline`, the title reads `Room offline: <room> (n of N devices)`, and `device_*` describe the first device that went offline.
- `issue=offline` also matches `space_offline`, since the filter is a substring match.

endpoints.title: Get Licenses
endpoints.description:
## Query parameters
All filters are optional and are combined with AND. Invalid values are rejected with `422 Unprocessable Entity`.

- `page` — page number (default `1`).
- `per_page` — results per page (default `100`, **max `100`**). Values above `100` are rejected with `422 Unprocessable Entity`.
- `state` — **multi-value**: repeat the key (`state[]=available&state[]=inuse`) or pass a comma-separated list (`state=available,inuse`). Allowed values: `available`, `inuse`, `remove`, `error`, `disabled`, `renew`. Any other value is rejected.
- `assigned` — `true` / `false`. `true` returns licenses linked to a device **or** pre-bound to a serial number (`bound_device_sn`); `false` returns licenses with neither. It says nothing about the device's claim state.
- `device_id` — exact match, licenses assigned to that device.
- `product_id` — exact match on the license's product.
- `device_model_id` — exact match on the license's device model.
- `bound_device_sn` — exact match on the serial number the license is pre-bound to.
- `warranty` — `true` / `false`, whether the license is a warranty license.
- `transferable` — `true` / `false`, whether the license can be moved to another device.
- `expires_before` / `expires_after` — ISO-8601 datetime compared against `expires_at` (inclusive), e.g. `2026-01-31T23:59:59Z`. A value without a UTC offset is interpreted as UTC. Licenses without an expiry (`"expires_at": null`) are excluded by either filter.
- `order_short_id` — exact match on the short id of the order the license was purchased under.

Results are always sorted by `created_at` descending (ties broken by `id`); the sort order is not client-configurable.

## States
Beyond the six filterable values above, a response may also contain the internal transitional state `disable` (a license on its way to `disabled`). It is not accepted as a `state` filter value.

## Success
**200 OK** — paginated list of licenses. `next_page` is the next page number, or `null` on the last page.
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "3f6b1c5e-2f19-4c1a-9a41-1c0d9b2f7a84",
      "state": "inuse",
      "expires_at": "2026-07-31T23:59:59Z",
      "activated_at": "2025-06-30T09:12:44Z",
      "payment_interval": "yearly",
      "duration": 365,
      "warranty": false,
      "transferable": true,
      "bound_device_sn": null,
      "created_at": "2025-06-29T14:03:11Z",
      "order_short_id": "ORD-4K7Q2M",
      "partner": { "id": "8ac2...", "name": "Acme AV" },
      "device": { "id": "c66308c8-1d12-...", "sn": "Q3RzbMS8-..." },
      "product": { "id": "1f9d...", "name": "Device Monitoring" },
      "device_model": { "id": "7b21...", "name": "Digital Media Player" }
    }
  ],
  "next_page": 2
}
```
Fields:

- `payment_interval` — how the license was bought: `one_time`, `monthly`, `yearly` or `usage_based` (billed monthly).
- `duration` — the license term in days (`30` monthly and usage-based, `365` yearly, `21915` — 60 years — one-time, the coverage term for a one-time warranty).
- `expires_at` — a hard cut-off, not the billing period. For `monthly` / `yearly` subscriptions it is the end of the paid period plus a 2-month billing grace period, and moves forward on every successful charge. `usage_based` licenses expire like `monthly` ones. `one_time` licenses expire about 100 years after purchase, i.e. effectively never.

Nullable fields:

- `device` — `null` for a license that is not assigned to a device. A license matched by `assigned=true` with `"device": null` is pre-bound to the serial number in `bound_device_sn`.
- `device_model` — comes from the purchased product, so it is populated whether or not the license is assigned to a device; `null` only when the product has no device model.
- `product` — `null` when the license is not linked to a product.
- `order_short_id` — `null` when the license was not created through a purchase.
- `payment_interval` — `null` when the license was not created through a purchase.
- `duration` — `null` only on older licenses created outside the store purchase flow; every store purchase records it.

endpoints.title: Create Maintenance Schedule
endpoints.description:
Creates a recurring maintenance window on the space in the path. It applies to the space and every space below it.

## Body
- `days` — required, one or more of `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`: the weekdays the window starts on. An overnight window set on `fri` runs from Friday night into Saturday morning.
- `start` — required, `HH:MM` (`00:00`–`23:59`), local time in the space's timezone.
- `end` — required, `HH:MM` (`00:00`–`24:00`). An `end` at or before `start` runs into the next day; `00:00`–`24:00` is the whole day. `end` must differ from `start`.
- `name` — optional, up to 255 characters.
- `enabled` — optional, default `true`.

A space holds at most 10 schedules. The space comes from the path only; a schedule cannot be moved to another space.

## Success
**200 OK** — the schedule, in the shape of an item of Get Maintenance Schedules.

## Errors
**422 Unprocessable Entity** — a missing field, an unknown day, an empty `days`, a malformed time, `start` equal to `end`, or an 11th schedule on the space:
```json
{ "error": "days must be among mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun" }
```
```json
{ "error": "days must not be empty" }
```
```json
{ "error": "start must be a time formatted HH:MM" }
```
```json
{ "error": "end must differ from start" }
```
```json
{ "error": "Space cannot have more than 10 maintenance schedules" }
```
**403 Forbidden** — scheduled maintenance is not enabled for the organization:
```json
{ "error": "Scheduled maintenance is not enabled for this organization" }
```
**404 Not Found** — no such space in the organization.

endpoints.title: Delete Maintenance Schedule
endpoints.description:
Deletes the schedule. The incidents it was hiding that are still open are announced as new incidents, unless another window still covers their space.

## Success
**200 OK**
```json
{ "success": true }
```

## Errors
**403 Forbidden** — scheduled maintenance is not enabled for the organization:
```json
{ "error": "Scheduled maintenance is not enabled for this organization" }
```
**404 Not Found** — no such schedule in the organization.

endpoints.title: Get Maintenance Schedules
endpoints.description:
Lists the organization's recurring maintenance windows. An incident opened on a device while a window covers its space is suppressed: it stays on the device but is left out of incident lists, counts and integrations, and is announced as a new incident if it is still open when the window ends. Windows set on a space apply to every space below it.

Scheduled maintenance is enabled per organization by Xyte. Until it is, every Maintenance Schedules endpoint answers **403 Forbidden** (`Scheduled maintenance is not enabled for this organization`), devices and spaces report no scheduled maintenance, and no incident is hidden.

## Query parameters
- `page` — page number (default `1`).
- `per_page` — results per page (default `100`, **max `100`**).
- `space_id` — optional, only the schedules set on this space (not the ones it inherits).
- `enabled` — optional, `true` / `false`.
- `active` — optional, `true` / `false`: whether the schedule's own window covers the current time. A disabled schedule is never active.

## Success
**200 OK** — paginated list of schedules, oldest first.
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "3c1e2f4a-8b7d-4c6e-9f10-...",
      "name": "Nightly",
      "days": ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"],
      "start": "02:00",
      "end": "06:00",
      "timezone": "Europe/Paris",
      "enabled": true,
      "space": { "id": 17517, "name": "Paris Office", "path": "Green Energy Corp/France/Paris Office" },
      "active": false,
      "until": null,
      "next_start_at": "2026-10-21T00:00:00Z",
      "next_end_at": "2026-10-21T04:00:00Z",
      "created_by": { "id": "9d2b6a10-...", "name": "Jane Doe" },
      "created_at": "2026-10-20T09:12:44Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-10-20T09:12:44Z"
    }
  ],
  "next_page": null,
  "total_count": 1
}
```
- `days` — the weekdays the window starts on: `mon` … `sun`. An overnight window (`end` at or before `start`) set on `fri` runs from Friday night into Saturday morning.
- `start` / `end` — local wall-clock time `HH:MM` in the timezone of the schedule's space (falling back to its customer space, then UTC). An `end` at or before `start` runs into the next day; `00:00`–`24:00` is the whole day.
- `timezone` — the IANA timezone `start` / `end` are evaluated in: the schedule's space's, else its customer space's, else `Etc/UTC`.
- `active` — the schedule's own window covers the current time.
- `until` — when the schedule's current window ends (UTC) while `active` is true, `null` otherwise.
- `next_start_at` / `next_end_at` — the next window of this schedule that starts after now (UTC), `null` when none starts within 7 days.
- `created_by` — the user who signed in for the OAuth token that created it; `null` when created with an API key.
- `total_count` — how many schedules match the filters across all pages.

endpoints.title: Create Coupon
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature and store coupons enabled for the partner (403 otherwise).

## Body
- `name` — required.
- `code` and/or `organization_tag_id` — at least one. A code is redeemed by the customer; a tag hands the coupon to every organization carrying it.
- `discount_type` — `percent` with `percent_off` (1-100), or `fixed_amount` with `amount_off` and `currency`.
- `amount_off` — in major units of `currency` (12.34 USD, 500 JPY); more decimals than the currency has is rejected, never rounded. `currency` must be one of the store currencies.
- `store_listing_id` — optional; omitted means the whole store.
- `starts_at` / `ends_at` — optional ISO 8601 exact instants with a UTC offset; `ends_at` is exclusive. See "Dates" below.
- `active` — defaults to true.

## Dates
Send a time and a UTC offset, e.g. `2026-01-31T09:00:00Z`, `2026-01-31T09:00:00+02:00` or `2026-01-31T09:00:00+0200`. A date alone (`2026-01-31`) or a time without an offset (`2026-01-31T09:00:00`) returns **422** `starts_at must be an ISO 8601 time with a time zone offset (Z or +hh:mm), e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z` (or `ends_at ...`).

The Partner portal shows dates in the viewer's time zone. To match "valid from <first day> through <last day>":
- `starts_at` — midnight that starts the first day, in the user's time zone. Example: `2026-12-01T00:00:00-05:00`.
- `ends_at` — the last millisecond of the last day, in the same time zone. Example: `2026-12-31T23:59:59.999-05:00`. This is what the portal stores for "through Dec 31".
- Do not send midnight of the next day (`2027-01-01T00:00:00-05:00`). The portal then shows Jan 1 as the end date.
- If you do not know the user's time zone, ask for it.

## How coupons apply
- A customer gets the coupons of its organization tags plus the coupons it redeemed by code.
- Per product, price interval and currency, the store applies one coupon: the one with the largest discount. Coupons never add up. On a tie, the older coupon wins.
- A coupon applies only while it is active, after `starts_at` and before `ends_at`.

## Free and minimum prices
The coupon is checked against every price it targets: every listing for a whole-store coupon, or the one listing. A `fixed_amount` coupon checks only prices in its currency.
- **422** `Coupon would make the <interval> price of '<listing name>' free` — the discount is equal to or larger than a monthly or yearly price.
- **422** `Coupon would bring the <interval> price of '<listing name>' below the minimum charge` — the price left is above 0 but below the minimum charge (the equivalent of 0.70 USD).
- One-time prices may become free (0). They may not end between 0 and the minimum charge.
- Create the coupon first. Add the tag to organizations only after the coupon exists.

## Success
**201 Created** — the new coupon, in the shape of Get Coupons.

**200 OK** — an identical coupon of the partner already exists (a safe retry). It is returned in the same shape and nothing is created.

## Errors
- **403** — brand partner API key (read-only).
- **404** — `organization_tag_id` or `store_listing_id` is not the partner's.
- **422** — validation, e.g. `Code is not available` (the code is taken, including by this partner's coupon with different fields), `amount_off has too many decimal places for USD`, a `starts_at` / `ends_at` without a time or an offset.

## Success
**204 No Content**.

## Errors

endpoints.title: Get Coupons
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature and store coupons enabled for the partner (403 otherwise).

## Success
**200 OK** — the partner's coupons, newest first.

## Query
- `page` — starts at 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100. Any other value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`.
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-a1",
      "name": "Gold 10",
      "code": null,
      "discount_type": "fixed_amount",
      "percent_off": null,
      "amount_off": 12.34,
      "currency": "USD",
      "active": true,
      "status": "active",
      "starts_at": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "ends_at": null,
      "organization_tag": { "id": "....-d75e0abec7d2", "name": "Gold" },
      "store_listing": { "id": "....-c3", "name": "Pro plan" },
      "tagged_organizations_count": 12,
      "redemptions_count": 0,
      "used_in_orders": true,
      "created_at": "2026-02-20T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- `amount_off` — in major units of `currency` (12.34 USD, 500 JPY).
- `status` — `active`, `scheduled` (before `starts_at`), `expired` (from `ends_at` on) or `inactive`.
- `starts_at` / `ends_at` — exact instants; `ends_at` is exclusive. The portal stores "through Dec 31" as `ends_at` = Dec 31, 23:59:59.999 in the user's time zone (see Create Coupon).
- Per product, interval and currency, the store applies one coupon: the one with the largest discount. Coupons never add up.
- `redemptions_count` — code redemptions only, so always 0 for a tag-only coupon. `tagged_organizations_count` — organizations carrying the coupon's tag.

endpoints.title: Update Coupon
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature and store coupons enabled for the partner (403 otherwise).

## Body
Takes the fields of Create Coupon. Only the fields sent change:
- An omitted field keeps its value.
- A field sent as `null` is cleared, e.g. `"code": null`, `"store_listing_id": null` (the whole store) or `"ends_at": null`.
- `active: false` stops the coupon at once; `active` cannot be `null`.
- `amount_off` without `currency` is in the coupon's currency.
- `currency` without `amount_off` keeps the amount in major units, e.g. 5 USD becomes 5 JPY. If the amount does not fit the new currency's decimals, send `amount_off` too.
- Changing `discount_type` clears the other type's fields: `percent_off` on a switch to `fixed_amount`, `amount_off` and `currency` on a switch to `percent`.
- Dates follow the rules of Create Coupon: a time with a UTC offset is required. For "valid through Dec 31" in New York, send `"ends_at": "2026-12-31T23:59:59.999-05:00"`. A date alone or a time without an offset returns **422** and the coupon is not changed.
- When a discount field changes, the free and minimum-price checks of Create Coupon run again.

Sending the same body again changes nothing and returns the same coupon.

## Success
**200 OK** — the coupon, in the shape of Get Coupons.

## Errors
- **403** — brand partner API key (read-only).
- **404** — the coupon, `organization_tag_id` or `store_listing_id` is not the partner's.
- **422** — validation, e.g. `Code is not available`, `active must be true or false`, `percent_off must be a whole number`, a `starts_at` / `ends_at` without a time or an offset.

endpoints.title: Approve Order
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). Approves an order waiting for the seller's approval (`approval_state` `pending_approval` in Get Orders). **This cannot be undone.**

Approving creates the purchased products and emails the customer that the order is approved. For an order with physical items, the partner is emailed too. The order records the calling API key as its approver: `approved_by` is `{ "type": "api_key", "name": "<key name>" }`.

## Body
- `warranty_start_dates` — optional object `{ "<order_item_id>": "YYYY-MM-DD" }`. Required for every warranty item of the order (`warranty: true` in Get Order); dates already stored for an item (`warranty_start_at` in Get Order) may be left out. Item ids are matched case-insensitively.

The body is checked before the order's state: a malformed body gets 422 even on an order that is already approved. On an already approved order, valid dates are ignored and the stored ones stay.

## Success
**200 OK** — the order, in the shape of Get Order, with `approval_state` `approved`.

Approving an order that is already approved returns **200 OK** with the order and changes nothing (no second email; `approved_by` keeps the first approver).

## Errors
- **401** — missing or invalid API key.
- **403** — brand partner API key (read-only), or the partner has no Store plan feature.
- **404** — unknown order, or another partner's order. Returned before the body is checked.
- **422** `Order does not require approval` — the order was never held for approval.
- **422** `Order is not waiting for approval` — e.g. the order is not paid yet, or is a purchase order not yet approved.
- **422** `warranty_start_dates must be an object` — the value is not a JSON object (`null` counts as absent).
- **422** `Warranty start date of order item <id> must be a YYYY-MM-DD date` — the value is not a real calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form (for example `2026-02-30` or `15/01/2026`), or not a string (`null` included).
- **422** `A warranty start date is required for every warranty product before the order can be approved` — a warranty item has no date.
- **422** `Unknown order item <id>` / `Order item <id> is not a warranty product` — a key of `warranty_start_dates` is wrong.

endpoints.title: Get Order
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). One order with its items, renewal orders included. **404** for an order outside the partner (for a brand partner: outside its brands).

## Success
**200 OK** — every field of Get Orders, plus `items`:
```json
{
  "id": "....-a1",
  "short_id": "ORD-JL8K3",
  "currency": "USD",
  "subtotal": 25,
  "...": "as in Get Orders",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "....-e5",
      "name": "Camera",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unit_list_price": 15,
      "unit_price": 12.5,
      "line_total": 25,
      "payment_interval": "one_time",
      "product": { "id": "....-f6" },
      "store_listing": { "id": "....-a7" },
      "subscription_id": null,
      "coupon": { "id": "....-b8", "name": "Spring" },
      "coupon_discount": 5,
      "seller_discount": 2,
      "seller_discount_type": "recurring",
      "warranty": false,
      "warranty_start_at": null
    }
  ]
}
```
- Money is a JSON number in major units of the order's `currency` (12.5 USD, 500 JPY), with a fraction when the amount has one; a money field is `null` when it does not apply.
- `unit_list_price` — the unit price before any coupon; `null` for an item bought with no coupon price recorded (most orders); `coupon_discount` is then `null` too.
- `unit_price` — the unit price after any coupon, per `payment_interval`.
- `line_total` — the amount charged for the line under the store's pricing (all units; for a first monthly or yearly purchase, the prorated first period or the prepaid term). It is computed when read, not a stored charge.
- `payment_interval`:
  - `one_time` — a single charge.
  - `monthly` — billed every month.
  - `yearly` — billed every year.
  - `usage_based` — billed by metered usage.
- `coupon_discount` — what the coupon saved on the whole line (`unit_list_price` minus `unit_price`, for all units and the charged period); `0` when the item has a `unit_list_price` but no coupon, `null` when `unit_list_price` is `null`.
- `seller_discount` — the seller's discount on the whole line; `null` without one.
- `seller_discount_type`:
  - `one_time` — taken off the first charge only.
  - `recurring` — taken off every charge.
- `coupon` — `{ id, name }` of the coupon used on the line; `null` when no coupon was used or the coupon was deleted later (`coupon_discount` stays set).
- `subscription_id` — the subscription the line belongs to, when it has one.
- `warranty` — `true` for a warranty item; Approve Order needs a warranty start date for each of these.
- `warranty_start_at` — the warranty start date stored for a warranty item (`YYYY-MM-DD`, e.g. `2026-01-15`); `null` for other items and for a warranty item with no date yet. Set it with Approve Order.

endpoints.title: Get Orders
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The store orders of the partner (for a brand partner: of its brands), newest first (`created_at`, then `id`, both descending), so two pages never overlap.

## Query
- `page` — 1 or more, default 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100.
- `created_from` — orders created at or after this time (inclusive).
- `created_to` — orders created before this time (**exclusive**); must be later than `created_from` when both are set.
Both times are ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.ffffff]]` with a time zone offset, `Z`, `±hh:mm` or `±hhmm`, e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Send `+` URL-encoded as `%2B` (`created_from=2026-01-01T02:00:00%2B02:00`); a raw `+` reads as a space and is rejected.
- `organization_id` — orders of one organization (UUID).
- `coupon_id` — orders with at least one item bought with this coupon (UUID).
- `short_id` — exact order number, e.g. `ORD-JL8K3`; must not be empty.
- `reference_id` — exact reference the buyer entered; must not be empty.
- `fulfillment_status` — one of `fulfillment_status` below.
- `payment_status` — one of `payment_status` below. An order whose `payment_status` is `null` matches no value.
- `pending_approval` — `true` or `false`. `true`: only orders waiting for your approval (`approval_state` = `pending_approval`); `false`: every other order.
- `include_renewals` — `true` or `false`; `true` adds subscription renewal orders; default `false` (first purchases only).

An invalid value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`: `page` below 1, `per_page` out of range, a boolean that cannot be read (`'maybe' is not a valid boolean`), an empty `short_id` or `reference_id` (`Parameter short_id cannot be blank`), an unknown or empty enum value (`Parameter fulfillment_status must be one of the following: order_placed / processing / ...`), an empty or malformed time or one without an offset, `created_to` not later than `created_from` (`created_to must be after created_from`), or an id that is not a UUID (`organization_id must be a valid UUID`).

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-a1",
      "short_id": "ORD-JL8K3",
      "reference_id": "PO-77",
      "created_at": "2026-01-15T10:00:00.000Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "subtotal": 25,
      "tax": 1.25,
      "total": 26.25,
      "payment_method": "credit_card",
      "payment_status": "paid",
      "approval_state": "not_required",
      "approved_at": null,
      "approved_by": null,
      "fulfillment_status": "shipped",
      "tracking_number": "1Z999",
      "is_renewal": false,
      "partner": { "id": "....-b2", "name": "Acme" },
      "organization": { "id": "....-c3", "name": "Contoso" },
      "payment": { "id": "....-d4" },
      "coupon_names": ["Spring"],
      "total_coupon_discount": 5
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- Money (`subtotal`, `tax`, `total`, `total_coupon_discount`) is a JSON number in major units of the order's `currency` (12.5 USD, 500 JPY), with a fraction when the amount has one. `total` = `subtotal` + `tax`. `total_coupon_discount` is what coupons saved on the order, 0 without coupons.
- `organization` — `null` when the order has none.
- `payment` — `{ id }` of the order's payment; `null` when the order has no payment. Its status is `payment_status`. An `offline` payment is not available from Get Payments or Get Payment (404).
- `payment_method`:
  - `credit_card` — paid by card in the store.
  - `purchase_order` — paid against a purchase order (PO) file.
  - `offline` — paid outside the store.
  - `lab` — a test order placed by a Lab Account; nothing is charged.
- `payment_status` — `null` when the order has no payment; the `payment_status` filter cannot select such orders. A payment with the legacy status `expired` reads as `uncollectible`, and the `uncollectible` filter matches it. Otherwise:
  - `pending` — payment not settled yet (not a purchase order).
  - `awaiting_po_upload` — purchase order: the buyer has not uploaded the PO file yet.
  - `awaiting_po_approval` — purchase order: PO file uploaded, waiting for approval.
  - `paid` — paid.
  - `failed` — the charge failed; it may be retried.
  - `uncollectible` — given up on collecting.
  - `archived` — the unpaid order was archived.
  - `refunded` — paid, then refunded.
- `approval_state`:
  - `not_required` — the order needs no seller approval.
  - `approved` — you approved the order (`approved_at`).
  - `pending_approval` — paid and waiting for your approval.
  - `awaiting_payment` — needs approval, but not paid yet (or approved as part of the purchase order step).
- `approved_by` — who approved the order; `null` when nobody did, when the approving portal user was later removed, or for an order approved before this field was recorded.
  - `{ "type": "api_key", "name": "ERP sync" }` — approved through the Partner API (Approve Order) with this API key of yours. `name` is the key's name at the time of approval; it stays after the key is renamed or deleted.
  - `{ "type": "user", "id": "....-e5", "name": "Dana Cohen" }` — approved by this user in the partner portal (for a purchase order: the user who approved the PO).
- `fulfillment_status`:
  - `order_placed` — not paid yet.
  - `processing` — paid; physical items wait for shipment.
  - `missing_information` — paid; the buyer still owes post-purchase details.
  - `available` — paid; digital items are available.
  - `ready` — shipment ready to ship.
  - `shipped` — shipment shipped (`tracking_number`).
  - `delivered` — shipment delivered.
  - `cancelled` — the order was cancelled.
  - `cancelled_during_ready` — cancelled while its shipment was ready.
- `is_renewal` — `true` for an order a subscription renewal created.

endpoints.title: Get Organizations
Add Organization Tag
endpoints.description:
Attaches a partner organization tag to an organization, creating the tag on first use. Tag names are case-insensitive; up to 50 tags per organization.

- Tags cannot be deleted. They can only be removed from organizations.
- A tag added with an API key shows no "added by" person in the Partner portal.
- To give a tag a coupon, create the coupon first (Create Coupon). Add the tag to organizations after that.
- `note` — optional, up to 1000 characters.
- To change the note, use Update Organization Tag.

## Success
**200 OK** — the tag is attached. If it was already attached, the existing note is kept.
```json
{
  "id": "....-d75e0abec7d2",
  "name": "Gold",
  "color": null,
  "note": "Renewed in May",
  "added_at": "2026-05-04T09:00:00.000Z",
  "added_by": null,
  "store_visible": true,
  "coupons": [{ "id": "....-a1", "name": "Gold 10", "status": "active", "source": "tag" }]
}
```
- `id` — the organization tag id, used as `organization_tag_id` when creating a coupon.
- `color` — the tag color, `null` when none is set.
- `added_at` — when the tag was attached to this organization.
- `added_by` — `{ "id", "name" }` of the person who attached the tag in the Partner portal, or `null` when the tag was attached with an API key or the user is no longer known.
- `coupons` — every coupon now applied to the organization (same list as GET organizations: `source` `tag` or `code`, empty without the Store plan feature or the `store_coupons` flag); a tag coupon discounts the customer only when `store_visible` is true.

## Errors
- **403** — brand partner API key (read-only).
- **404** — the organization is not visible to the partner.
- **422** — `name` is blank, `note` is an object or an array or longer than 1000 characters, or the organization already has 50 tags.

endpoints.title: Get Organization Tags
Remove Organization Tag
endpoints.description:
Removes one of the partner's tags from an organization. The tag itself stays. Tags cannot be deleted.

## Success
**200 OK**:

```json
{
  "coupons_removed": [
    { "id": "....-a1", "name": "Gold 10" }
  ]
}
```

`coupons_removed` lists the coupons the organization got through this tag and no longer gets. A coupon that still reaches it through another tag, or that it redeemed by code, is not listed. It is empty without the Store plan feature or store coupons, or when the organization is not `store_visible`.

## Errors
- **403** — brand partner API key (read-only).
- **404** — the organization is not visible to the partner, or the tag is not attached to it (including a second remove of the same tag).

endpoints.title: Update Organization Tag
endpoints.description:
Changes the note of one of the partner's tags on an organization. The note belongs to this organization only; the tag on other organizations keeps its own note.

- `note` — required, up to 1000 characters. `null` or `""` clears the note.
- A changed note is recorded in the partner audit log, attributed to the API key. The note text is not recorded.

## Success
**200 OK** — same body as Add Organization Tag:
```json
{
  "id": "....-d75e0abec7d2",
  "name": "Gold",
  "color": null,
  "note": "Renewed in June",
  "added_at": "2026-05-04T09:00:00.000Z",
  "added_by": { "id": "....-77", "name": "Dana Levi" },
  "store_visible": true,
  "coupons": [{ "id": "....-a1", "name": "Gold 10", "status": "active", "source": "tag" }]
}
```

## Errors
- **403** — brand partner API key (read-only).
- **404** — the organization is not visible to the partner, or the tag is not attached to it.
- **422** — `note` is missing, an object or an array, or longer than 1000 characters.

endpoints.title: Get Payment
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). One payment. **404** for a payment with no order of the partner (for a brand partner: of its brands), or one made outside the store (`offline`).

## Success
**200 OK** — the same fields as one item of Get Payments:
```json
{
  "id": "....-d4",
  "status": "paid",
  "currency": "USD",
  "subtotal": 25,
  "tax": 1.25,
  "total": 26.25,
  "payment_method": "credit_card",
  "created_at": "2026-01-15T10:00:00.000Z",
  "paid_at": "2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "failure_reason": null,
  "is_renewal": false,
  "organization": { "id": "....-c3", "name": "Contoso" },
  "order_ids": ["....-a1"],
  "invoices": [{ "id": "....-e5", "status": "issued", "note": "Net 30" }]

```
See Get Payments for the meaning of each field and status value. Money is in major units of `currency`. **The totals are your share of the payment, not the buyer's full charge**: they are the amounts of your orders on the payment (for a brand partner: its brands' orders), tax included.

endpoints.title: Get Payments
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The store payments for the partner's orders (for a brand partner: its brands' orders), newest first (`created_at`, then `id`, both descending), so two pages never overlap. Payments made outside the store (`offline`) are not listed. A buyer may pay for orders of several partners in one checkout; that payment is listed once, with only your orders' amounts.

## Query
- `page` — 1 or more, default 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100.
- `created_from` — payments created at or after this time (inclusive).
- `created_to` — payments created before this time (**exclusive**); must be later than `created_from` when both are set.
- `organization_id` — payments of one organization (UUID).
- `status` — one of `status` below.

Both times are ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.ffffff]]` with a time zone offset, `Z`, `±hh:mm` or `±hhmm`, e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Send `+` URL-encoded as `%2B` (`created_from=2026-01-01T02:00:00%2B02:00`); a raw `+` reads as a space and is rejected.

An invalid value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`: `page` below 1, `per_page` out of range, an unknown or empty `status` (`Parameter status must be one of the following: pending / paid / failed / uncollectible / archived / refunded`), an empty or malformed time or one without an offset, `created_to` not later than `created_from` (`created_to must be after created_from`), or an id that is not a UUID (`organization_id must be a valid UUID`).

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-d4",
      "status": "paid",
      "currency": "USD",
      "subtotal": 25,
      "tax": 1.25,
      "total": 26.25,
      "payment_method": "credit_card",
      "created_at": "2026-01-15T10:00:00.000Z",
      "paid_at": "2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z",
      "failure_reason": null,
      "is_renewal": false,
      "organization": { "id": "....-c3", "name": "Contoso" },
      "order_ids": ["....-a1"],
      "invoices": [{ "id": "....-e5", "status": "issued", "note": "Net 30" }]
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- Money (`subtotal`, `tax`, `total`) is a JSON number in major units of `currency` (12.5 USD, 500 JPY), with a fraction when the amount has one. **The totals are your share of the payment, not the buyer's full charge**: they are the amounts of your orders on the payment (for a brand partner: its brands' orders), tax included, not other partners' orders paid in the same checkout. `total` = `subtotal` + `tax`.
- `status`:
  - `pending` — not settled yet (for a purchase order: waiting for the PO file or its approval).
  - `paid` — paid.
  - `failed` — the charge failed; it may be retried.
  - `uncollectible` — given up on collecting. A payment stored with the legacy status `expired` reads as `uncollectible`, and the `uncollectible` filter matches it.
  - `archived` — the unpaid payment was archived.
  - `refunded` — paid, then refunded.
- `payment_method`:
  - `credit_card` — paid by card in the store.
  - `purchase_order` — paid against a purchase order (PO) file.
  - `lab` — a test payment by a Lab Account; nothing is charged.
- `paid_at` — the latest date one of your orders on the payment was marked paid (midnight UTC; the time of day is not stored); `null` while it is not paid. A refunded payment keeps it.
- `failure_reason` — the card processor's message for the last failed charge. It stays when the payment later turns `uncollectible` or `archived`, and is cleared once it is paid; `null` when no charge failed.
- `is_renewal` — `true` when any of your orders on the payment is a subscription renewal.
- `organization` — the buying organization; `null` when the payment has none.
- `order_ids` — your orders on the payment (Get Order reads one).
- `invoices` — invoices of those orders, newest first; `note` is your note on the invoice (`null` without one). Invoice `status`:
  - `pending` — not issued yet.
  - `issued` — issued to the buyer.
  - `void` — cancelled.
- Card details, payment processor ids and invoice files are not returned.

An invalid value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`: `page` below 1, `per_page` out of range, a boolean that cannot be read (`'maybe' is not a valid boolean`), or an unknown or empty `type` (`Parameter type must be one of the following: physical / device_license / ...`).

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-f6",
      "name": "Camera",
      "sku": "CAM-1",
      "type": "physical",
      "category": "Video",
      "pricing_model": "standard",
      "partner": { "id": "....-a1", "name": "Acme AV" },
      "archived": false,
      "created_at": "2026-01-01T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- `sku`, `category` — free text the partner set; `null` or empty when not set.
- `type`:
  - `physical` — a shipped item.
  - `device_license` — a license for one device.
  - `platform_license` — a license for the organization, in use from purchase and not bound to a device.
  - `warranty` — a warranty for a device the customer already owns.
- `pricing_model`:
  - `standard` — fixed prices set on the store listing.
  - `usage_based` — billed by metered usage.
  - `personalized` — priced per order by the seller instead of a list price; the portal store does not show these listings.
- `partner` — the partner that owns the product; for a brand partner, the brand it belongs to.
- `archived` — `true` when the product was archived; it can no longer be sold.

endpoints.title: Get Sold Product
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). One sold product. **404** for a product the partner did not sell (for a brand partner: its brands did not sell). The 404 body is `{ "error": "Sold product not found" }`.

## Success

```json
{
  "id": "....-a1",
  "created_at": "2026-01-05T09:12:44.120Z",
  "redeemed_at": null,
  "subscription_id": null,

}
```

endpoints.title: Get Sold Products
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The products the partner sold: products it owns, and products of other partners sold through its store listings (for a brand partner: those of its brands). Newest first (`created_at`, then `id`, both descending), so two pages never overlap.

## Query
- `page` — 1 or more, default 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100.
- `organization_id` — sold products of one organization (UUID).
- `order_id` — sold products of one order (UUID).
- `product_id` — sold products of one product (UUID).
- `redeemed` — `true`: the license was redeemed; `false`: the license was not redeemed, including sold products without a license. Without it, both. A product sold directly to an organization is never redeemed, so `false` does not mean unclaimed.

An invalid value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`: `page` below 1, `per_page` out of range, a `redeemed` value that cannot be read (`'maybe' is not a valid boolean`), or an id that is not a UUID (`organization_id must be a valid UUID`, `order_id must be a valid UUID`, `product_id must be a valid UUID`).

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-a1",
      "created_at": "2026-01-05T09:12:44.120Z",
      "redeemed_at": "2026-01-06T10:00:00.000Z",
      "order_id": "....-b2",
      "subscription_id": "....-c3",
      "organization": { "id": "....-d4", "name": "Contoso" },
      "product": { "id": "....-e5", "name": "Cloud Plan" },
      "device": { "id": "....-f6", "sn": "SN-0001", "model": "Room Controller" }
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- `redeemed_at` — when the organization redeemed the license with its shareable token; `null` otherwise, and when there is no license. It stays `null` for a product sold directly to an organization.
- `order_id` — the order the product was sold in (see Get Order). The order belongs to the seller; when a reseller sold your product, Get Order answers 404 for it.
- `subscription_id` — the subscription of a recurring purchase; `null` for a one-time purchase. The subscription belongs to the product's owner; when you sold another partner's product through your store listing, Get Subscription answers 404 for it.
- `organization` — `{ id, name }` of the organization that owns the sold product; `null` while it is not assigned to one.
- `product` — `{ id, name }` of the product sold. The product can belong to another partner whose product you sold through your store listing; Get Product with this `id` then returns **404**.
- `device` — `{ id, sn, model }` of the device the license is assigned to, `model` being the device model's name; `null` when there is no license, it is not assigned, or the device is scheduled for deletion.
- The license shareable token and the device MAC are not returned. The shareable token is available in the partner portal only.

endpoints.title: Get Store Listing
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). One store listing. **404** for a listing outside the partner (for a brand partner: outside its brands).

## Success
**200 OK** — the fields of one Get Store Listings item:
```json
{
  "id": "....-c3",
  "name": "Remote care",
  "status": "published",
  "pricing_model": "standard",
  "partner": { "id": "....-a1", "name": "Acme AV" },
  "product": { "id": "....-f6", "type": "device_license" },
  "prices": [
    { "currency": "USD", "one_time_price": 10.5, "monthly_price": 20, "yearly_price": null }
  ]
}
```
- `name` — the name shown in the store; the product's name when the listing has none of its own.
- `status`:
  - `draft` — not in the store yet.
  - `published` — in the store.
  - `archived` — removed from the store.
- `pricing_model` — the product's: `standard`, `usage_based` or `personalized` (see Get Products).
- `partner` — the partner that owns the listing; for a brand partner, the brand it belongs to.
- `product` — the product the listing sells; `type` as in Get Products. The product can belong to another partner that shares it with you; Get Product with this `id` then returns **404**.
- `prices` — one row per currency, sorted by currency; amounts in major units, `null` when the listing has no such price. The rate of a `usage_based` listing is not returned.

endpoints.title: Get Store Listings
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The partner's store listings (for a brand partner: the listings of its brands), in store order. Store order is set per partner, so a brand's list mixes its brands' listings. Use an `id` as a coupon's `store_listing_id`; a brand partner's coupons cannot use its brands' listings.

## Query
- `page` — starts at 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100. Any other value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`.

## Success
**200 OK**:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-c3",
      "name": "Remote care",
      "status": "published",
      "pricing_model": "standard",
      "partner": { "id": "....-a1", "name": "Acme AV" },
      "product": { "id": "....-f6", "type": "device_license" },
      "prices": [
        { "currency": "USD", "one_time_price": 10.5, "monthly_price": 20, "yearly_price": null }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```

- `status` — `draft`, `published` or `archived`.
- `pricing_model` — a coupon can target only a `standard` listing.
- `partner`, `product` — the owning partner and the product the listing sells; see Get Store Listing.
- `prices` — one row per currency; amounts in major units, `null` when the listing has no such price.

endpoints.title: Get Store Settings
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The store settings of the key's own partner. A brand partner's key gets the brand's own settings, not those of its brands.

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "currencies": ["USD", "EUR"],
  "default_currency": "USD",
  "payment_methods": ["credit_card", "purchase_order"],
  "orders_require_approval": false,
  "tax_enabled": true
}
```
- `currencies` — ISO 4217 codes the store sells in; a `standard` or `usage_based` listing was priced in each of them when it was published (a `personalized` listing has no prices), so a currency added later can be missing from older listings' `prices` (for a brand partner, its brands' listings follow their own currencies).
- `default_currency` — the currency shown first; one of `currencies`.
- `payment_methods` — the methods buyers can pay with; empty when both are off:
  - `credit_card` — card payment at checkout.
  - `purchase_order` — the buyer sends a purchase order and pays by invoice.
- `orders_require_approval` — `true` when a new order waits for your approval before it is processed. An order with a `warranty` product always waits for approval, whatever this says.
- `tax_enabled` — `true` when tax is calculated on orders that have a tax address.

endpoints.title: Get Subscription
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). One subscription. **404** for a subscription outside the partner (for a brand partner: outside its brands). The 404 body is `{ "error": "Subscription not found" }`.

## Success
**200 OK** — the same object as one entry of Get Subscriptions `data`:
```json
{
  "id": "....-a1",
  "status": "active",
  "amount": 12.5,
  "currency": "USD",
```

endpoints.title: Get Subscription Invoice Items
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The charges of one subscription: the first purchase and every renewal, one item each, newest first (`created_at`, then `id`, both descending). **404** for a subscription outside the partner (for a brand partner: outside its brands). The 404 body is `{ "error": "Subscription not found" }`.

## Query
- `page` — 1 or more, default 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100.

`page` below 1 or `per_page` out of range returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`.

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-a1",
      "created_at": "2026-02-05T00:10:02.311Z",
      "order_id": "....-b2",
      "start_period": "2026-02-05",
      "end_period": "2026-03-05",
      "currency": "USD",
      "price": 37.5,
      "payment_status": "paid",
      "paid_at": "2026-02-05T00:00:00.000Z",
      "invoice_id": "....-c3"
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- `order_id` — the order of the charge (see Get Order; renewal orders included).
- `start_period`, `end_period` — dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the period the item charges for.
- `price` — the item's unit price (after any coupon) times its quantity, a JSON number in major units of `currency`; seller discounts, proration and prepaid terms are not applied (see `line_total` in Get Order for the charged amount). `null` when no price is recorded.
- `payment_status` — the order's payment status, with the values of `payment_status` in Get Orders; `null` when the order has no payment.
- `paid_at` — when the order was paid; `null` while unpaid.
- `invoice_id` — the newest invoice of the order; `null` when it has none.

endpoints.title: Get Subscriptions
endpoints.description:
Requires the Store plan feature (403 otherwise). The store subscriptions on the partner's products (for a brand partner: on its brands' products), newest first (`created_at`, then `id`, both descending), so two pages never overlap.

## Query
- `page` — 1 or more, default 1.
- `per_page` — optional, 1-500, default 100.
- `status` — one of `status` below.
- `organization_id` — subscriptions of one organization (UUID).
- `next_charge_from` — subscriptions whose next charge is at or after this time (inclusive).
- `next_charge_to` — subscriptions whose next charge is before this time (**exclusive**); must be later than `next_charge_from` when both are set.
`next_charge_at` is a date; the filters read it as 00:00 UTC of that day. A subscription without a next charge (`null`) matches neither filter. Both times are ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.ffffff]]` with a time zone offset, `Z`, `±hh:mm` or `±hhmm`, e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Send `+` URL-encoded as `%2B` (`next_charge_from=2026-01-01T02:00:00%2B02:00`); a raw `+` reads as a space and is rejected.

An invalid value returns **422** with `{ "error": "..." }`: `page` below 1, `per_page` out of range, an unknown or empty `status` (`Parameter status must be one of the following: active / pending_cancellation / canceled / suspended`), an empty or malformed time or one without an offset, `next_charge_to` not later than `next_charge_from` (`next_charge_to must be after next_charge_from`), or an id that is not a UUID (`organization_id must be a valid UUID`).

## Success
**200 OK**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "....-a1",
      "status": "pending_cancellation",
      "created_at": "2026-01-05T09:12:44.120Z",
      "payment_interval": "monthly",
      "amount": 12.5,
      "currency": "USD",
      "payment_method": "credit_card",
      "next_charge_at": null,
      "canceled_at": "2026-03-02T10:00:00.000Z",
      "canceled_scheduled_at": "2026-04-05T00:00:00.000Z",
      "cancellation_details": { "reason": "too_expensive", "comment": "Moving to annual", "initiator": "buyer" },
      "organization": { "id": "....-b2", "name": "Contoso" },
      "product": { "id": "....-c3", "name": "Cloud Plan" },
      "order_id": "....-d4",
      "quantity": 1,
      "purchased_product_id": "....-e5",
      "device": { "id": "....-f6", "sn": "SN-0001" },
      "latest_payment_id": "....-a7",
      "latest_payment_status": "paid"
    }
  ],
  "page_info": { "has_next": false, "total_count": 1 }
}
```
- `amount` — the recurring price of one unit, a JSON number in major units of `currency` (12.5 USD, 500 JPY), with a fraction when the amount has one. For a usage-based product it is the base monthly price, before usage. It is not the charged amount: see `price` in Get Subscription Invoice Items for each charge.
- `status`:
  - `active` — charged every period.
  - `pending_cancellation` — canceled; runs until `canceled_scheduled_at`, then becomes `canceled`.
  - `canceled` — ended.
  - `suspended` — on hold and its license suspended; a paid renewal makes it `active` again.
- `payment_interval`:
  - `monthly` — charged every month.
  - `yearly` — charged every year.
- `payment_method` — as in Get Orders (`credit_card`, `purchase_order`, `offline`, `lab`).
- `next_charge_at` — date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the next charge; `null` once a cancellation is scheduled (usage-based: the end of the cancellation month, for the final usage charge).
- `canceled_at` — when the cancellation was requested; `null` if never canceled.
- `canceled_scheduled_at` — when a scheduled cancellation takes effect; `null` otherwise.
- `cancellation_details` — `{ reason, comment, initiator }`, `null` if never canceled. `reason` and `comment` are what the canceling user entered. `initiator`:
  - `buyer` — canceled by the organization.
  - `seller` — canceled by a partner user.
  - `system` — canceled by Xyte (no user).
  - `user` — older cancellations, before buyer and seller were told apart.
- `organization` — `{ id, name }` of the buying organization.
- `order_id` — the order that started the subscription (see Get Order). The subscription belongs to the product's owner; when a reseller sold the order, Get Order answers 404 for it.
- `quantity` — the units bought in that order; `null` when it is not recorded.
- `device` — `{ id, sn }` of the device the subscription's license is assigned to; `null` when there is no license or it is not assigned.
- `latest_payment_id`, `latest_payment_status` — the payment of the newest invoice item (see Get Subscription Invoice Items); `null` when it has no payment. `latest_payment_status` has the values of `payment_status` in Get Orders.
- No buyer, address or card data is returned.
